title: build:candidate fails open outside CI: a laptop run packs the committed platform binaries and stamps them with the current sourceCommit
description: Dispatched by opum-agent 2026-09-29 (relayed from opum-cli-e2e measurement ~16:10Z on dev d034a239) and reproduced first-party the same day. scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs run outside CI packs the committed platform packages -- the previous release (0.11.0) bytes -- yet stamps evidence/package-metadata.json with sourceCommit d034a239 and artifactProvenance "committed", whose own comment promises "the bytes that publish". Reproduced: the local run exits 0 and writes a full bundle; the packed darwin-arm64 binary rejects --across-refs (exit 2, "Unrecognized flag"), while the dev source serves it (exit 0). So the bundle confidently misdescribes its contents, and a qualifier that trusted the metadata would have exercised the wrong bytes and reported PASS. The script header says in prose that it must run in CI after the platform matrix, never a laptop; nothing enforced that. Fix direction from the dispatch: fail closed when the packed platform artifacts do not correspond to the source tree, or refuse to stamp a sourceCommit over committed bytes -- whichever is simpler, proven red then green. A conforming bug fix, not a design question; it does not block the pair release, since CI builds the matrix, but it should land before the RC.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Off a release ref, a run whose platform binaries are all byte-identical to the committed blobs (the laptop shape) exits non-zero with a refusal naming the reason, and writes nothing: no output directory is created, no evidence/package-metadata.json exists, and the working tree is left byte-identical including package.json.

The release path is unchanged: with the release-ref environment set (GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v...), committed platform artifacts still build a bundle stamped with that sourceCommit and artifactProvenance committed -- the bytes that publish.
The dispatch path is unchanged: off a release ref, platform artifacts that differ from the committed blobs still build, stamped artifactProvenance rebuilt with rebuiltPlatforms naming them.
The focused suite proves the refusal red and the two accepted shapes green, and bun run check exits 0 under the pinned bun 1.4.2.

definitionOfDone.text: Delivered as a PR into dev with source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check green on the head the closing evidence cites (newest row per context, no pending rows).

plan: 1. Record the reproduced red: a laptop run on dev packs the committed 0.11.0 binaries and stamps sourceCommit d034a239 with artifactProvenance committed; the packed darwin-arm64 binary rejects --across-refs (exit 2) while the dev source serves it (exit 0).

2. scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs: refuse off a release ref when zero platforms were rebuilt -- committed bytes cannot honestly be stamped as this source; and move the rebuilt/provenance computation above the root package.json mutation so no refusal path leaves the tree dirty. Say in the header that the CI-only rule is now enforced.

3. test/e2e/release/candidate-bundle.test.ts: violating shape (committed, off-ref) red; release-ref committed green; off-ref rebuilt green; release-ref rebuilt still fatal. The two contract tests building committed fixtures carry releaseRef.
4. Prove under pinned bun 1.4.2: focused suite then bun run check; a live laptop run refuses writing nothing with a byte-identical tree; a live release-ref run still builds.
5. Branch fix/QCLI-419-candidate-bundle-fail-closed off origin/dev, commit, push bare, PR into dev, wait on the head check-runs (newest per context, no pending rows).

6. Close in the same PR: ACs checked with evidence, final summary citing the PR and the validating run plus the commit it covers; squash merge bare, delete the local branch, fetch and read origin/dev.
implementationNotes: RED REPRODUCED first-party 2026-09-29 on dev d034a239. `node scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs --out /tmp/qcli-buildcandidate-prefix-red` exits 0 and writes evidence/package-metadata.json with sourceCommit d034a2393d03db56dc4b2d37a279219da5e10acf, artifactProvenance "committed", version 0.11.0, rebuiltPlatforms absent. The working-tree darwin-arm64 binary reports 0.11.0 and rejects the dev syntax: `task list --across-refs` exits 2 ("--across-refs requires a value"); `task list --across-refs=dev` exits 2 ("Unrecognized flag --across-refs. Accepted flags: --status, --label, ..."). The dev source serves the same command at exit 0. So the bundle packed the previous release bytes while its metadata names d034a239 as sourceCommit with provenance "committed" -- the false-confidence shape the dispatch described. Tree byte-identical (git status clean) after the run.

IMPLEMENTED. scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs: the rebuilt/provenance computation moved ABOVE the root package.json mutation (so no refusal can leave that mutation behind), and a new refusal fires when zero platforms were rebuilt off a release ref -- committed bytes cannot honestly be stamped as this source. Header prose now states the CI-only rule is enforced. scripts/build-candidate-bundle.d.mts comment updated. Tests: new commitFixture helper; the two contract fixtures now initialize a real repository, because measured while fixing this: OUTSIDE a repo `git diff` runs in --no-index mode and exits 1 for an inaccessible path, which reads as all-rebuilt -- the old fixtures were silently exercising that misread since nothing asserted provenance there. PROOFS under pinned bun 1.4.2: pre-fix script + new tests = 6 pass 1 fail (the violating shape did NOT refuse); post-fix = 7 pass 0 fail. Live laptop run off a release ref: exit 2, refusal message, no out dir created, tree untouched. Live release-ref run (GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v0.11.0-tagsim, --launcher-rc 1): exit 0, 7 staged archives, staged launcher 0.11.0-rc.1, metadata artifactProvenance committed with sourceCommit stamped. Full bun run check: in flight.

FULL CHECK GREEN under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check exit 0, 1050 pass / 0 fail, 7437 expect() calls across 116 files (5 pre-existing lint warnings elsewhere, non-failing). Only invocation sites of the bundle build are the workflow candidate-bundle job (dispatch/tags) and the manual npm script; test/qcli399-launcher-equivalence.test.ts imports resolveRcNumber only. No in-repo consumer requires the old off-ref behavior; e2e-receipt.mjs requires artifactProvenance committed, which remains the release-tag shape.

INDEPENDENT ADVERSARIAL REVIEW COMPLETE (subagent, 2026-09-29), four findings triaged:
F4 (MEDIUM, verified by mutation): the ordering move had no test coverage -- reverting it left the suite 7/7 green. FIXED: the refusal path now asserts the root package.json is byte-identical after the refusal, and the mutant (mutation block moved back above the rebuild check) now reddens exactly that assertion (1 fail / 7 pass), proven locally.
F1 (MEDIUM, verified): the guard refuses only when ZERO platforms were rebuilt; a partial set (e.g. one locally built platform) still builds labeled "rebuilt" with rebuiltPlatforms naming the difference, while the header and d.mts prose read distributively. Mechanism kept (AC3 blesses the partial case; changing it is a design question); prose tightened to "NO rebuilt platform package" in the header, "an all-committed set" in the d.mts, and the changelog headline now reads "refuses an all-committed artifact set off a release ref".
F3 (LOW, verified) + F2 main mouth (MEDIUM-LOW, verified): an unresolvable 40-hex commit contributed nothing to `rebuilt`, so the refusal named committed artifacts rather than the real cause; and a directory with no repository behind it read all-rebuilt and BUILT a bundle (git --no-index mode). FIXED with a resolvability guard before the rebuild check (`git rev-parse --verify --quiet <commit>^{commit}`; refuses naming that as the cause). New test covers both shapes; against the pre-fix script the new tests redden exactly 2 (guard test + violating shape), 6 pass.
F5 (LOW, inferred): a pack failure still leaves the root package.json rewrite behind (restore runs only on success paths) -- pre-existing, out of ACs, not a regression. Filed as QCLI-420 (To Do) riding this PR.
Review verdict: correct and complete against the four ACs as written; the reviewer also independently verified AC1-AC3 live from scratch fixtures, the release-path-exemption mutant (3 red, matching the prediction read off the test file), consumer impact (e2e-receipt requires committed = release-tag shape only), and no AMFI/SIGKILL exposure. Post-fix: focused suite 8 pass / 0 fail; live laptop refusal re-verified exit 2 writing nothing; full check re-run in flight on the final code.
finalSummary: LANDED as opum-ai/quest-cli#441 for dev; validated by the PR-triggered source-gates run 36598333198 (success) on code head dda53bdf, with the push-triggered run 36598323127 also green on that SHA and Tracker integrity and lore check green on the same head (newest row per context, no pending rows). The closing record commit rides the same PR; the merge gate covers the final head. WHAT SHIPPED: off a release ref, a candidate bundle with NO rebuilt platform package refuses before writing anything -- committed bytes are an earlier release build, not this source bytes; the rebuild/provenance evaluation moved above the root package.json rewrite so no refusal leaves that mutation behind; and a resolvability guard (git rev-parse --verify --quiet <commit>^{commit}) refuses first when the commit cannot be resolved at all, closing the no-repository (git --no-index mode) and absent-commit holes found in review. Release-ref committed artifacts and off-ref rebuilt artifacts keep their accepted behavior; the release-ref-plus-rebuilt fatal is unchanged. EVIDENCE, pinned bun 1.4.2 printed for every run: live laptop run off a release ref -> exit 2, refusal naming the reason, no output directory, tree byte-identical; live release-ref run (GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v0.11.0-tagsim --launcher-rc 1) -> exit 0, 7 staged archives, staged launcher 0.11.0-rc.1, metadata artifactProvenance committed with sourceCommit stamped; focused suite 8 pass / 0 fail; full bun run check 1051 pass / 0 fail; lore check 0 errors. Mutation proofs: the pre-fix script against the new tests is 6 pass / 2 fail (exactly the violating shape and the resolvability test), and the ordering mutant reddens exactly the package.json byte-identity assertion (1 fail / 7 pass). REVIEW: independent adversarial review (subagent) verdict correct and complete against the four criteria; four findings, three folded in here (ordering coverage added, prose tightened to NO-platform / all-committed, resolvability guard) and the residual pack-failure mutation leak filed as QCLI-420 (To Do, rides this PR as a record only). A measured test-fidelity fix rode along: outside a repository git diff runs in --no-index mode and exits 1 for an inaccessible path, so the two contract fixtures now initialize a real repository. NO RELEASE: dev stays unpromoted by opum-agent standing instruction (pair release); version remains 0.11.0.
